name: phoenix-open-issue
author: 上海锟钛
description: Open Issue List 管理 Web 应用 — 多列表协作、组织层级推送、点检追踪

scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k -n core,server,web -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm dev:core" "pnpm dev:server" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.build: pnpm build:core && pnpm build:server && pnpm build:web
scripts.build:local-wing:consumers: pnpm build:core && pnpm build:server && pnpm -C packages/web build:local-wing
scripts.build:deploy: pnpm build:core && pnpm -C packages/web exec vite build
scripts.start:prod: NODE_ENV=production pnpm -C packages/server exec tsx src/main.ts
scripts.verify:ci: pnpm docs:check && pnpm verify:wing-dependencies && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.verify:local-wing:consumers: pnpm docs:check && pnpm verify:wing-dependencies && pnpm test && pnpm run build:local-wing:consumers
